preconditions.description: Input integers n and k are within the bounds 1 ≤ n, k ≤ 5·10^5.
The string s has exactly n lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output string has exactly length k.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output string consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: any(all(stdout[i] == s[i % len(s)] for i in range(k)) for s in [s, s + s, s + s + s, ...] if len(s) <= k)
postconditions.description: The output string can be obtained by a sequence of delete-last-character and duplicate-string operations on the original string s.

postconditions.expression: not any(stdout < candidate for candidate in [candidate for s in [s, s + s, s + s + s, ...] if len(s) <= k for candidate in [s[:k], s[:k-1] + s[:k-1], ...] if len(candidate) == k])
postconditions.description: The output string is lexicographically smallest among all possible strings of length k obtainable by the operations.
